scripts.build: BUILD_ID=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d.%H%M%SZ) && npx esbuild main.jsx --bundle --conditions=source --inject:react-globals.js --loader:.css=text --loader:.svg=dataurl --banner:js='/*! Bundles WEBMIDI.js (c) Jean-Philippe Cote, Apache-2.0, https://webmidijs.org - see @enkerli/webmidi/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md */' --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --minify --outfile=dist/bundle.js && sed "s/__BUILD_ID__/$BUILD_ID/g" index.html > dist/index.html && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp ../../packages/ui/fonts/*.woff2 dist/fonts/
scripts.dev: BUILD_ID=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d.%H%M%SZ) && npx esbuild main.jsx --bundle --conditions=source --inject:react-globals.js --loader:.css=text --loader:.svg=dataurl --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"development\" --sourcemap --outfile=dist/bundle.js && sed "s/__BUILD_ID__/$BUILD_ID/g" index.html > dist/index.html && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp ../../packages/ui/fonts/*.woff2 dist/fonts/
